title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force SureCart versions up to and including 4.13.0. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing an attacker with low privileges to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
